name: CH coactivation before conditional joint ablation
phase_1: 64 fixed prompts: 24 CH words and 8 non-CH words, two output cases. Scan naturally gated input-word contributions with zero-strength hooks; compare exactly to unhooked native baseline.
phase_2_eligibility: CH prompts where each of L3-T2334 and L29-T2334 has a positive gate on at least one token overlapping the input target word in the unmodified native pass. Also report whether both are active at the same token.
joint_semantics: Recompute each selected gate and low-rank operator from that condition current residual; in both_off L29 is evaluated downstream of the L3 edit. Subtract estimated naturally gated contribution from native MLP at target input tokens only. Generated tokens unedited; native remainder retained.
metrics: Greedy text; immediate next-token mass for CH/ch variants; same-native-prefix answer-slot CH/ch mass; expected-prefix mass; log odds of target mass vs all other tokens. None is full-sequence correctness probability.
selection_reporting: Gate selection precedes ablation outcomes. Report all scanned words, including inactive cases and controls; joint intervention only on eligible CH prompts.
non_goals: No unrelated-feature specificity controls in this targeted coactivation/joint follow-up
No claim of exhaustive CH feature discovery or feature absorption
